title: Descent
style: grainy found-footage still from a handheld camcorder and headlamps, deep uncharted limestone cave, harsh white headlamp beams cutting total darkness, wet glistening rock, VHS noise and lens flare, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. Three friends filmed their way into an uncharted cave. Only the tapes came out. 🔦

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: This footage was found in 2024, in a waterproof case, at the mouth of a cave on a nameless ridge. The three people who filmed it were never found.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a scuffed waterproof equipment case lying on wet rock at the dark mouth of a cave

scenes.narration: Priya, Lou and Dev had already mapped two caves on that ridge. The third opening wasn't on any survey. They called it Cave 3.
scenes.image: grainy daylight camcorder still of three young adult cavers in helmets and headlamps on a rocky ridge, grinning

scenes.narration: Tape one. Daylight. Priya grins into the lens. Lou checks the ropes. Dev says, for the record, this is a terrible idea.
scenes.image: grainy handheld still of a bearded man in a caving helmet coiling climbing rope, shaking his head at the camera

scenes.narration: The entrance is a crack barely wider than a person. Cold air pours out of it. Lou says caves breathe. This one is exhaling.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a narrow black crack in a rock face, mist drifting out, a gloved hand on the rock

scenes.narration: They squeeze through one at a time. The passage opens into a chamber so big their lights can't find the far wall.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of an enormous dark cave chamber, three thin beams vanishing into blackness

scenes.narration: Water drips. Breath fogs in the beams. Dev counts heads out loud, like he always does. One. Two. Three.
scenes.image: grainy close headlamp still of a caver's face, breath fogging in the harsh white light, water droplets falling

scenes.narration: Priya pans the camera across the darkness. And stops.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still panning across black wet cave rock, motion blur, lens flare from a headlamp

scenes.narration: Far away, deep in the chamber, there's a light. A single headlamp. Steady. Pointed right at them.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of total cave darkness with one small distant headlamp glowing far away

scenes.narration: Lou calls out. Hello? The echo comes back. Then, a few seconds later, it comes back again. Closer.
scenes.image: grainy still of a caver cupping his hands to shout into a vast dark cave, headlamp beam swallowed by the dark

scenes.narration: Dev counts again, quieter this time. One. Two. Three. And far in the dark, the fourth headlamp blinks off.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of three huddled cavers lit by their own headlamps, pitch-black cave behind them
